neighbours.label: the purpose noun after 'for' naming what something is being prepared for (for reprint, for export, for shipment, for distribution), as against 'for' with durations and prices
fire: The old letters were scanned and corrected for publication next year.
Most of the coffee grown here is roasted for export to Europe.
The paintings were carefully crated for transport to the museum.
The lecture notes were revised for distribution to the students.
Fresh fish are packed in ice for delivery to restaurants downtown.
The interviews were transcribed for broadcast on public radio.
The cars are built in Ohio for sale in Canada and Mexico.
Tissue slices were stained and mounted for viewing under the microscope.
quiet: The old letters were kept in a drawer for nearly forty years.
Most of the coffee grown here is sold for about two dollars a pound.
The paintings were stored in the basement for a long time.
The lecture notes were lost for a week before turning up.
Fresh fish are kept on ice for a few hours at most.
The interviews lasted for about an hour each.
The cars are built in Ohio, where the plant has run for decades.
Tissue slices were left in the fridge for two days.
